description: Lets MentorU send email from your domain by adding the DNS records that prove you allow it: the bounce address (MX and SPF on the send label) and the DKIM signing key. To use a subdomain such as mail.example.com, pass the subdomain as the host parameter.
variableDescription: mxRegion is the Amazon SES region of the bounce server, for example us-east-1. dkimKey is the public DKIM key without the leading p=.
